sents.t: There’s a challenge I think, especially if people make very loud public proclamations about things.
sents.zh: 我觉得有个难题，尤其是当人们对事情发表非常高调的公开宣言时。
gloss: 一道需要用力才能翻过去的坎
站在高处，大声向所有人宣布。

sents.t: You mentioned there about, you’re almost a hostage to the things that you used to say.
sents.zh: 你刚才提到，你几乎成了自己过去说过的话的人质。

sents.t: Being able to update your opinions and change your mind looks very similar to the internet as hypocrisy does.
sents.zh: 能更新观点、改变想法，在网上看起来和虚伪非常像。
gloss: 把旧的换成最新的版本。
脑子里的路牌换了方向。
嘴上一张脸，背后另一张脸。

sents.t: The difference between me saying something in the past and saying something different now is perhaps I’ve learned, perhaps I’ve updated my beliefs.
sents.zh: 我过去说的和现在说的不一样，区别也许在于我学到了东西，也许我更新了自己的信念。

sents.t: But so few people do it in a legitimate way.
sents.zh: 但很少有人以正当的方式这样做。

sents.t: I think that the grifter shill—you’d see this is the smoking gun that shows that he didn’t really believe that thing all along.
sents.zh: 我觉得那种骗子、托儿——你会看到，这就是确凿的证据，说明他从一开始就没真正相信过那件事。
gloss: 收了钱假装真心推荐的人。
从起点一路到现在都是。

sents.t: I went to a retreat in LA a couple of years ago, and there was a guy that I used to follow, a big business and productivity advice content creator, really successful,
sents.zh: 几年前我去洛杉矶参加了一个静修营，那里有个我以前关注过的人，一个做商业和效率建议的大内容创作者，非常成功，
gloss: 躲进安静的地方歇一歇。
同样的时间做出更多活。

sents.t: and he just totally stepped back from everything, went monk mode and focused on his business.
sents.zh: 后来他彻底从一切中抽身，进入“僧侣模式”，专心做自己的生意。
gloss: 像和尚一样关起门只做一件事。
